description: This file defines extension methods for Memory<byte> and ReadOnlyMemory<byte> types to retrieve ArraySegment<byte> representations, with error handling if the memory is not backed by an array.

classes.name: BufferExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for memory buffer types.

methods.name: GetArray (Memory<byte>)
methods.description: Returns an ArraySegment<byte> from a Memory<byte> instance by delegating to the ReadOnlyMemory<byte> version.

methods.name: GetArray (ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an ArraySegment<byte> from ReadOnlyMemory<byte> using MemoryMarshal.TryGetArray; throws InvalidOperationException if not backed by an array.
